refinement.detail: Searched and found none THAT THIS TICKET MAY APPLY. RD-01 is a measurement of the historical record and its standing rule is FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING. Five refinements were found and all five are filed rather than applied: RD-01-DF-01 through RD-01-DF-05. Two of them are refinements of this repository's own instruments (the tripwires that walk gitignored vendored homes, and rule 5's unexecuted third-pass clause) and applying either would have changed an instrument inside the round using it. THE RECORD ITSELF WAS NOT REFINED: nineteen counted figures are refuted and every one of them is still in the tree, because never edit a target to match a result.

behavior_tests.evidence: uv run --with pytest --with pyyaml python -m pytest tests -q -> 2 failed, 1428 passed in 622.07s. Parent 7136c3a in the same checkout: 2 failed, 1405 passed. THE TWO FAILURES ARE IDENTICAL AT BOTH ENDS and are environmental -- every hit is inside the gitignored .claude/ and .skill-manager/ per-checkout homes that `wt new` creates, and filtered to tracked files both report zero. Filed as RD-01-DF-02 rather than repaired, per measurement_rule. Reporting this as `pass` with the two reds named is the honest form; calling it green would be the claim this ticket exists to refuse.

descriptor_comparison.evidence: No produced code and no model changed, so there are no before/after descriptor figures to compare. What RD-01 measured instead is the RECORD, and that comparison is specs/results/scorecards/reading-discipline/GOAL-scope-loss-catchable/RD-01.md with its raw output in scope-sweep.txt and contested.txt.

tlc_after.evidence: Same reason. The close reports `direction=zero (vs SM-05)`, which is the measured confirmation that no representation moved. The bound being OVER CAP at 111.1% is inherited from SM-05 and is a LOWER bound over 7 of 9 resolved variables; RD-01 did not touch it and resolving it here would be a change made during a measurement.

tlc_before.evidence: RD-01 changed no model. Ticket current and desired are byte-identical as scaffolded and the plan records `model_delta_expectation: none expected`. Its whole implementation scope is eval harness -- examples/validation/scorecards/, references/eval_scorecard.md, tests/ -- which is deliberately outside the program surface. There is no pre-change model to run TLC against because there is no change.

assertions: An unscoped D<n> = k on N of N claim is refused when the underlying cards span more examples than it admits.
contested computes: a spread > 1 sets the flag and index reports it.
Judge tier is a first-class recorded field and a tier split is visible.
Each check ships a demonstrated FAILING input run against the REAL historical claims, not a fixture.

ticket.objective: FIRST AND ALONE. subtract-to-measure was justified by 'D2 = 2 on 27 of 27 cards', true of ONE example, restated unscoped in the charter, the plan and the issue, and verified with a script containing `if "ab_quota_ledger" not in f: continue`. Make that catchable: a claim of the form 'D<n> = k on N of N cards' must carry its scope and something must refuse it when the underlying cards span more examples than the claim admits. SWEEP the existing charters, plans and issues -- those claims are data. Make CONTESTED COMPUTE: rule 5 says a spread > 1 is contested and needs a third pass, nothing implements it, and index printed a dash on all four rows of a round where a spread of 2 existed. And record JUDGE TIER as a first-class field: opus judged D3 2,2 and sonnet 4,3 on the same artifact while D2 agreed across tiers, and nothing surfaces that.
